title: Mitigating stereotypical biases in text to image generative systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating images generated from neutral text prompts by using a vision-language model (BLIP-2) to classify the subjects' perceived skin tones into light, medium, or dark categories, and then calculating the Disparate Impact (DI) ratio to measure fairness.

Evaluating images generated from neutral text prompts by using a vision-language model (BLIP-2) to classify the subjects' perceived gender (male or female), and then calculating the Disparate Impact (DI) ratio to measure representation fairness.
